harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a hairpin routing chain (node3→node1→node2→node4) so TCP/23 traffic from node3 to node4 traverses node1 then node2. node1 (VyOS) accepts and logs the flow via a forward-filter rule; node2 (OPNsense) blocks and logs the same flow via a pf rule inserted ahead of the default-allow rule. Demonstrated one connection attempt and captured the correlated accept/block log pair for the identical packet (matching IP ID) on both nodes. Completed the mandatory per-node restart protocol on all 4 nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart recovery verification.
actions_performed: Surveyed all 4 nodes' OS/images and network layout (VyOS on node1, OPNsense/FreeBSD on node2, Ubuntu 24.04 on node3/node4, all on flat 10.100.1.0/24)
Added persistent static host route on node3 (systemd-networkd drop-in) sending 10.100.1.13 traffic via node1
Added persistent static route on node1 (VyOS) sending 10.100.1.13 traffic via node2
Added VyOS forward-filter rule 10 on node1: accept+log tcp/23 from 10.100.1.12 to 10.100.1.13
Inserted an OPNsense pf rule on node2 (config.xml) ahead of the default-allow-LAN rule: block+log tcp/23 from 10.100.1.12 to 10.100.1.13, then ran configctl filter reload
Verified node2 SSH/management access remained functional after the filter reload
Ran a test connection (nc) from node3 to node4:23, confirmed refusal, and pulled the correlated node1 (accept) / node2 (block) log entries for the same packet
Captured healthy baselines (boot id / boot time, routes, firewall rule presence) on all 4 nodes
Rebooted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time via native mechanisms (VyOS reboot, FreeBSD shutdown -r now, Ubuntu reboot), polling each until exec access returned
Verified changed boot identity on each node post-restart (boot_id for Linux nodes, kern.boottime for FreeBSD)
Verified post-restart recovery: node1's route and firewall rule intact, node2's pf rule reloaded and active with forwarding enabled, node3's persisted route intact
Re-ran the end-to-end test attempt after all restarts and captured a fresh correlated accept/block log pair (matching IP ID 24573) confirming the setup survived reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 permits the node3->node4 tcp/23 traffic and records it
evidence.summary: VyOS forward-filter rule 10 (accept, log, tcp/23, 10.100.1.12->10.100.1.13) configured and shown active; kernel log shows ipv4-FWD-filter-10-A ACCEPT entries for the flow both pre- and post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 refuses the same traffic and records the refusal
evidence.summary: pfctl shows the inserted block/log/quick rule for 10.100.1.12->10.100.1.13:telnet; filter.log shows matching 'block,in' filterlog entries for the flow both pre- and post-restart

evidence.requirement: traffic actually crosses node1 then node2 (routing chain established)
evidence.summary: Static routes added: node3->node4 via node1 (10.100.1.10), node1->node4 via node2 (10.100.1.11); ip route get confirms correct path selection on node3

evidence.requirement: single attempt from node3 produces a correlated pair of log entries showing where traffic stopped
evidence.summary: nc connection attempt from node3 to node4:23 timed out; node1 kernel log and node2 filterlog show matching entries for the identical packet (same IP ID, same TCP source port/seq) - accepted at node1, blocked at node2 - both pre-restart (IP ID 61282) and post-restart (IP ID 24573)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart with boot-identity proof and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 9d3cb897...; reboot issued; post-restart boot_id b6051f88... (changed); route and firewall rule verified intact after reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart with boot-identity proof and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime sec=1788676605 (06:36:45); reboot issued; post-restart kern.boottime sec=1788676967 (06:42:47, changed); pf rule and forwarding sysctl verified intact/active after reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 restart with boot-identity proof and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bdd5de93...; reboot issued; post-restart boot_id 9815bb00... (changed); persisted static route to node4 verified intact after reboot
Baseline boot_id 28ae5f98...; reboot issued; post-restart boot_id 28d7963a... (changed), confirming genuine restart
